title: Shila, grandson of Rav Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Yalkut, Ezekiel, section 366](https://www.sefaria.org/Yalkut_Shimoni_on_Nach.366.1), he objects: “Is not rolling painful for the righteous?” The statement appears in [Ketubot 111a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.111a.21) under Rabbi Abba Sala Rabba.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Yalkut attributes the objection to Rav Shila, grandson of Rav Acha, and writes גלגול (“rolling”). Hyman’s Hebrew spells it גלגל.
The linked Bavli attributes the same objection to Rabbi Abba Sala Rabba.
